footer.tagline: Finding a technically sound, cost-effective and long-lasting solution for every project.

lead: We will find a technically sound, cost-effective
and long-lasting solution for your project.

deadlines.title: Deadlines are fixed in the contract
deadlines.body: We guarantee that they are met, because we manage every stage ourselves — from drawings to handover.

production.title: In-house production
production.body: We manufacture glass and aluminum structures on modern automated equipment and control quality at every stage of production.

engineering.title: Engineering calculations, not assumptions
engineering.body: Every solution is backed by reliability and safety calculations and complies with current building codes and standards.

savings.title: Savings throughout the entire service life
savings.body: We select materials and systems to optimize both the initial investment and the subsequent operating and energy costs.

materials.title: Materials from leading manufacturers
materials.body: We work with a number of leading international manufacturers of glass and aluminum systems and adhere to international quality and environmental standards.

transparency.title: Transparency at every stage
transparency.body: Solutions, materials, scope of work, cost and deadlines are agreed with you in advance and fixed in the contract.

aftercare.title: We stay by your side after handover
aftercare.body: Warranty and post-warranty service, plus technical support throughout the entire operation of the building.

title: One partner
for the entire
facade
sub: We design, manufacture, install and maintain.
The entire process with one trusted partner.

why.heading: The facade is a building’s calling card and its reliable protection for years to come
why.body: ROVEX takes on the full cycle of work: engineering design, in-house production of glass and aluminum structures, installation of facade subframes, cladding, glazing, and warranty and post-warranty service.

title: Consultation and
preliminary estimate
consulting.body: We study your needs and the specifics of the building, propose technical solutions and materials, and present a preliminary cost.

title: Survey, design and
contract
measuring.body: We take precise measurements and prepare the design and technical documentation. The agreed solutions, scope, cost and deadlines are fixed in the contract.

title: Production and installation
production.body: We manufacture the structures in our own workshop. Installation and cladding are carried out by experienced teams strictly according to the design and schedule, under technical supervision.

title: Handover and support
handover.body: We carry out a final quality check of all systems and work, hand over the building and continue to support it throughout its operation.
